% ADDED figure (2026-10-31), adapted from the user's PHY 513 Problem Set 8 solution; generated by qft-C/tools/hw8/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  ->-/.style={decoration={markings,mark=at position #1 with {\arrow{Stealth}}},postaction={decorate}}, ->-/.default=0.55,
  legdot/.style={circle,fill=figO,inner sep=0pt,minimum size=4pt},
  legout/.style={circle,draw=figO,fill=white,inner sep=0pt,minimum size=4.2pt,line width=0.7pt},
  vtxc/.style={densely dashed,line width=0.5pt,draw=figB},
  intl/.style={line width=0.8pt,draw=figR},
  extl/.style={line width=0.8pt,black},
  legn/.style={font=\tiny, text=figO!80!black, inner sep=1pt},
  fcap/.style={font=\scriptsize, align=center},
}
\newcommand{\lnum}[1]{\tikz[baseline=(c.base)]\node[draw,circle,inner sep=0.5pt,font=\tiny](c){#1};}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
% (a) oriented tadpole
\begin{scope}
  \node[font=\bfseries] at (-2.6,1.2) {(a)};
  \draw[vtxc] (0,0) circle (0.6);
  \node[legdot] (xin) at (-0.3,-0.2) {}; \node[legout] (yout) at (0.3,-0.2) {};
  \node[legout] (lout) at (-0.3,0.25) {}; \node[legdot] (lin) at (0.3,0.25) {};
  \draw[extl,->-] (-2.0,-0.2) -- (xin); \draw[extl,->-] (yout) -- (2.0,-0.2);
  \draw[intl,->-=0.5] (lout) .. controls (-1.6,1.9) and (1.6,1.9) .. (lin);
  \draw[<->,figR,line width=0.5pt] (-0.3,0.85) -- (0.3,0.85); \node at (0,0.85) {\footnotesize$\times$};
  \node[fcap] at (0,-1.75) {$S = 1$: the loop flip\\ would reverse the arrow};
\end{scope}
% (b) oriented fish, internal lines opposite
\begin{scope}[xshift=6.4cm]
  \node[font=\bfseries] at (-3.2,1.2) {(b)};
  \draw[vtxc] (-1.3,0) circle (0.6); \draw[vtxc] (1.3,0) circle (0.6);
  \node[legout] (e1) at (-1.55,0.25) {}; \node[legdot] (e2) at (-1.55,-0.25) {};
  \node[legdot] (p1) at (-1.0,0.25) {}; \node[legout] (p2) at (-1.0,-0.25) {};
  \node[legout] (q1) at (1.0,0.25) {}; \node[legdot] (q2) at (1.0,-0.25) {};
  \node[legout] (e3) at (1.55,0.25) {}; \node[legdot] (e4) at (1.55,-0.25) {};
  \draw[extl,->-] (e1) -- (-2.8,0.9); \draw[extl,->-] (-2.8,-0.9) -- (e2);
  \draw[extl,->-] (e3) -- (2.8,0.9); \draw[extl,->-] (2.8,-0.9) -- (e4);
  \draw[intl,->-=0.5] (q1) .. controls (0.5,1.2) and (-0.5,1.2) .. (p1);
  \draw[intl,->-=0.5] (p2) .. controls (-0.5,-1.2) and (0.5,-1.2) .. (q2);
  \draw[<->,figR,line width=0.5pt] (0,0.5) -- (0,-0.5); \node at (0.18,0) {\footnotesize$\times$};
  \node[fcap] at (0,-1.75) {$S = 1$: the two internal lines\\ run in opposite directions};
\end{scope}
% (c) oriented sunset
\begin{scope}[xshift=13.0cm]
  \node[font=\bfseries] at (-3.3,1.2) {(c)};
  \draw[vtxc] (-1.3,0) circle (0.6); \draw[vtxc] (1.3,0) circle (0.6);
  \node[legdot] (ein) at (-1.6,0) {};
  \node[legdot] (p1) at (-1.0,0.35) {}; \node[legout] (p2) at (-1.0,0) {}; \node[legout] (p3) at (-1.0,-0.35) {};
  \node[legout] (q1) at (1.0,0.35) {}; \node[legdot] (q2) at (1.0,0) {}; \node[legdot] (q3) at (1.0,-0.35) {};
  \node[legout] (eout) at (1.6,0) {};
  \draw[extl,->-] (-2.9,0) -- (ein); \draw[extl,->-] (eout) -- (2.9,0);
  \draw[intl,->-=0.5] (q1) .. controls (0.5,1.3) and (-0.5,1.3) .. node[above,black] {\lnum{1}} (p1);
  \draw[intl,->-=0.3] (p2) -- node[above,black,pos=0.5] {\lnum{2}} (q2);
  \draw[intl,->-=0.5] (p3) .. controls (-0.5,-1.3) and (0.5,-1.3) .. node[below,black] {\lnum{3}} (q3);
  \draw[<->,figR,line width=0.5pt] (0.45,-0.1) -- (0.45,-0.75);
  \node[fcap] at (0,-1.95) {$S = 2$: lines \lnum{2}, \lnum{3} both run left to right};
\end{scope}
\node[legdot] at (-2.2,-2.7) {}; \node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=west] at (-2.05,-2.7) {leg where the arrow enters the vertex ($\hat\phi$ leg)};
\node[legout] at (6.0,-2.7) {}; \node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=west] at (6.15,-2.7) {leg where the arrow leaves the vertex ($\hat\phi^\dagger$ leg)};
\end{tikzpicture}
